item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: The City's Legistar pages list the…
item.description: The City's Legistar pages list the amended development agreement (File 260724) and its zoning ordinance (File 260770) as approved by the Mayor and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Enactment Nos. 208-26 and 209-26). The Board gave the ordinances final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), per the Clerk of the Board's certificate in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment. The summary, an open question and the September 29 timeline entry still said enactment was not confirmed or still to come; they now match the Legistar pages. Both ordinances say 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a) and File 260724, in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment), which makes November 13, 2026 the effective date by our count, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text; the heights and uses in the enacted text are not yet checked against this record. The record's timeline now has an entry for the Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), before the Mayor's approval. Source: SF Board of Supervisors, Legistar, BOS File 260724 and File 260770 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745); Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachments: https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063745&GUID=68B0CE5F-84C2-4368-BF8D-EEA7D8B92E55 and https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063746&GUID=9EA91A49-BBF9-4471-9EA9-6E7BD33A4353.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: The Board's ordinance as enacted on…
item.description: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026 sets new height limits for Block 15 (Station A): 175 ft north, 190 ft south. They take effect 31 days after enactment, November 13, 2026 by our count; until then the earlier limits (145 ft north, 160 ft south) apply. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: Mayor approves the Amended… (Oct 13, 2026)
item.description: Mayor approves the Amended and Restated Development Agreement (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): Legistar lists both as 'Status: Passed' with 'Final action: 10/13/2026', 'Enactment date: 10/13/2026' and enactment numbers 208-26 (File 260724) and 209-26 (File 260770), and a history row '10/13/2026 ... Mayor ... APPROVED' for each. The Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes) is the previous entry on this timeline. October 13, 2026 is the enactment date, from the Clerk of the Board's listing (page read October 14 and again October 17, 2026); it is an event date. Both ordinances provide 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a), p. 56 of its 'Leg Final' attachment; File 260724, p. 10 of its attachment); counted from October 13, 2026 that is November 13, 2026, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text. (Oct 13, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13.

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: Board of Supervisors finally… (Oct 6, 2026)
item.description: Board of Supervisors finally passes the Amended and Restated Development Agreement ordinance (BOS File 260724) and the Planning Code and Zoning Map ordinance for the Potrero Power Station Special Use District (BOS File 260770): the Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachment to each file lists 'October 06, 2026 Board of Supervisors - FINALLY PASSED', 'Ayes: 11 - Chan, Chen, Dorsey, Fielder, Mahmood, Mandelman, Melgar, Sauter, Sherrill, Walton and Wong' (File 260724 attachment pp. 11-12; File 260770 attachment pp. 58-59), and the Clerk's certificate says each ordinance 'was FINALLY PASSED on 10/6/2026 by the Board of Supervisors'. The date is the Board's vote date, an event date. The Legistar history row for 10/6/2026 on each file's web page carries no action text, so the attachment is the source for this entry. The Mayor's approval and enactment followed on October 13, 2026 (next entry). (Oct 6, 2026). Source: SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-07; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: Station A (Block 15): the October 22…
item.description: Station A (Block 15): the October 22, 2020 Planning Commission action is now described as the office allocation (Motion 20801) and a loading Major Modification (Resolution 20802), with the adaptive-reuse design approved by the Planning Director on March 2, 2022, in the record, the map notes and the timeline. The 2024 annual compliance report is now described as reporting brick stabilization work on Station A but no adaptive-reuse construction. The unsupported '11-story' count and the 16,225 sq ft terrace figure were removed, the 2018 Draft EIR now backs the 65 ft and 1901-02 statements, and the map caveat no longer calls this existing building vacant land. A citation to the Planning Commission's website home page, standing in for the minutes, was replaced with the design-review memo, the Chronicle title and Meyers+ date were corrected, and the D4D publisher is shown as SF Planning. Source: SF Planning, Block 15 Design Review Approval (memo of 2022-02-24, approved 2022-03-02) (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); California Barrel Company, 2024 Annual Compliance Report, 2025-03-28 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Draft EIR, Volume 1, 2018-10 (https://sfmea.sfplanning.org/2017-011878ENV_DEIR_Volume_1.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: Developer (Fifth Space)… (~Jul 2026)
item.description: Developer (Fifth Space) requests a Development Agreement amendment to increase Station A's permitted height by 30 feet, among other changes, to make its 'smaller floorplate' more attractive to commercial tenants; the Planning Commission considered the request that week (Chronicle, July 29, 2026) and approved the amendment unanimously, sending it to the Board of Supervisors (SF Standard, August 3, 2026); the Board of Supervisors then passed the amendment package on first reading on Sep 29, 2026 (see the next entry) (~Jul 2026).
